HS Hana Sato Principal Designer · Plainview When to use A “Loved by” section on a landing or pricing page with eight or more quotes Social proof that should feel alive without asking for attention – it runs slowly and stops the moment someone reads When not to use Two or three quotes – show them side by side; a loop of three repeats too obviously A single hero quote or a case study – it deserves a static, larger layout Reviews people need to search or filter – use a list or grid Installation Add Testimonial Wall with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19. CLI Manual pnpm npm yarn bun Copy pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/testimonial-wall.json Usage example.tsx Copy import { TestimonialWall } from "@/components/ui/testimonial-wall"; const items = [ { quote: "We replaced three half-finished internal kits with it in a sprint.", name: "Lena Hartmann", role: "Design Lead", company: "Fieldnote", avatar: "/avatars/lena.jpg", rating: 5, }, { quote: "The motion is the part nobody notices – which is exactly the point.", name: "Jonas Weber", role: "Staff Engineer", company: "Ledgerline", verified: true, }, // … at least two quotes per column, ideally four or more ]; export function Testimonials() { return (

Testimonials

Loved by product teams

); } API reference TestimonialWall Prop Type Default Description items { quote, name, role?, company?, avatar?, rating?, verified? }[] – The quotes. avatar is a photo URL – without one the initials sit on a soft gray circle. rating (1–5) adds a small gray star row, verified a gray check beside the name columns 1 | 2 | 3 3 Most columns on a wide container; the wall itself drops to 2 below 740px and 1 below 480px of its own width speed number 28 Pixels per second of the first column; the others run about 15 % slower and faster, in alternating directions pauseOnHover boolean true Ease the hovered column to a stop and wind it back up on leave. Keyboard focus always stops its column label string "What customers say" Accessible name of the wall className string – Extra class on the wrapper. Set the height with --ui-tw-height (600px by default) and the edge fade with --ui-tw-fade (96px) Keyboard interactions Tab Moves through the quotes; the focused card's column stops and the card is nudged into view Shift or Tab Moves back; leaving the wall lets the columns run again Accessibility A labelled region; every quote is a figure with a blockquote and a figcaption, read out once – the copies that make the loop are aria-hidden and inert Keyboard focus stops the column, so a card never runs away from the focus ring Hover, focus and press-and-hold all stop the motion, which covers the WCAG pause requirement for moving content Star ratings are an image with a text label (“Rated 5 out of 5”), the check is labelled “Verified customer” Reduced motion shows every quote once in a static masonry grid Motion Each column repeats a measured set and wraps by exactly its height – no gap, no jump Columns alternate up and down at slightly different speeds and start at different points, so rows never line up One requestAnimationFrame loop eases a velocity per column: hover slows it to a stop over about a third of a second, leaving winds it back up Drag a column with the mouse to scrub it; letting go flings it with inertia before it settles back into its own pace The hovered card lifts 3px with a soft shadow while the rest of the wall dims a little Only runs while on screen; top and bottom edges fade out with a mask Responsive behavior Columns follow the wall's own width (3 / 2 / 1), so it works in a sidebar as well as full width One column on phones with 15px quotes; names win over role and company when space is tight – down to 320px without overflow Touch: vertical swipes keep scrolling the page (no scroll trap); pressing and holding a column pauses it to read Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually ) has the class dark or data-theme="dark" Performance Transforms only – no layout work per frame, and no React re-renders while it runs Avatars load lazily; the loop pauses while the wall is off screen Related Logo Marquee Social proof The endless “Trusted by” strip – a seamless loop that eases to a stop on hover, scrubs with inertia and lifts the hovered logo to colour Tilt Card Hover A card that tilts in 3D towards the pointer, with a soft glare that follows it and a smooth spring back Text Reveal Text Text that arrives word by word or letter by letter – each piece rises out of a soft blur as it scrolls into view affectUI · 54 components · 12 screens · 11 blocks · 24 illustrations · 8 motion effects affectUI Agent-ready React UI for AI products – one file each, no dependencies.
